caption: The drawing features a square composition bordered with a red outline. The interior background is filled with a deep blue color. In the center, a stylized plant or tree with pale beige stems and branches spreads outward. The plant has multiple elongated leaves colored in red and tipped with yellow. Several stylized tulip-like flowers in yellow and red appear along the branches, with one large central flower at the top. White dots accent the edges of the central flower. On either side of the large flower, there are two symmetrical, oval-shaped yellow and red objects with white dots outlining the edges. At the bottom center, a semicircular red shape with white dots is present, from which the main stem of the plant emerges. The design is highly symmetrical, with similar flower and leaf shapes distributed along both sides of the central axis. The outer border contains curved leaf and stem motifs in red, yellow, and white against the blue background.
title: Study for Proposed Portfolio "Decorated Chests of Rural Pennsylvania"
